title: Prototype the portable compute-ray data and traversal baseline
abstract:
## Question

Which Vulkan 1.3 core compute shape is a credible milestone baseline on the current engine and Windows development machine: shader-visible voxel/material representation and partitioning, software traversal algorithm, camera/ray generation, offscreen storage-image output, and capability-aware presentation? Build only the cheapest concrete artifact needed to compare viable shapes against the canonical scene, semantic hit expectations, device limits, edit-driven rebuild needs, and descriptive timing/resource evidence; record what the milestone may safely claim and which risks remain.
